title: A Metric for Semantic Graph Matching of No-Code Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.23233v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: No-code and agentic systems increasingly produce executable workflows, but workflows cannot be compared adequately as strings because typed operations, parameters, and directed connections jointly determine the artifact. We define a semantic graph-matching distance for finite attributed workflow graphs. A partial one-to-one node matching determines node-substitution and directed labelled-edge disagreement, while unmatched nodes incur a positive null cost. Under a fixed type hierarchy, encoder, field universe, and metric-compatible primitive distances, the objective is a metric on workflow graphs up to attributed isomorphism. A padded Hungarian procedure provides a scalable feasible upper bound distinct from the exact objective. We evaluate the metric on 4,705 public n8n exports, representing 2,282 distinct normalized-graph hashes, 73,057 nodes, and 469 observed node types. translated_title: 无代码工作流语义图匹配的度量方法
translated_abstract: 无代码系统与智能体系统日益产生可执行的工作流，但由于类型化操作、参数和有向连接共同决定了这一产物，工作流无法作为字符串进行充分比较。我们为有限属性化工作流图定义了一种语义图匹配距离。部分一一节点匹配决定了节点替换代价与有向标记边的分歧，而未匹配节点会产生正的空代价。在固定的类型层次结构、编码器、字段全集以及度量兼容的原始距离之下，该目标函数在属性同构意义下构成工作流图上的一个度量。一种填充匈牙利算法提供了区别于精确目标函数的可扩展可行上界。我们在4,705个公开的n8n导出文件上对该度量进行了评估，涵盖2,282个不同的归一化图哈希、73,057个节点和469种观测到的节点类型。在32,093次分支定界完整评估中，原始（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文为无代码工作流图首次定义了严格的语义图匹配度量，证明了其在属性同构意义下满足度量公理，并通过填充匈牙利算法给出可扩展的上界，在4,705个公开n8n工作流上完成了大规模验证。
en_tdlr: This paper defines a rigorous semantic graph-matching metric for no-code workflow graphs, proves it is a true metric up to attributed isomorphism, provides a scalable padded Hungarian upper bound, and validates it at scale on 4,705 public n8n workflows.
